fact: The Ministry of Vocational Training says vocational-training intake registrations were made available for the first time through the national digital government services portal, from 8 August 2026.
The Minister of Vocational Training says 82,383 candidates had registered through the national digital government services portal by 23 August 2026.
The High Commission for Digitalisation says the President recently officially launched the national digital government services portal Dzair Digital Services.
The article says the national portal currently carries 21 digital services, to rise to 62 by end-2027 and 350 by 2028.
El Watan reports around forty digital public services are to be integrated into the National Public Services Portal as a first step.

Echaab reports that administrative services have expanded through the dzair digital services portal, simplifying procedures in vital sectors, citing the High Commission for Digitalisation's achievements.

The High Commission for Digitalisation, with the National Hajj and Umrah Office, added a new 'Hajj digital services' service to the national portal for government digital services, announced in a statement of 11 September 2026 for the 1448H/2027 season, with citizens asked to open portal accounts first.

fact: Algeria launched the national government digital services portal Dzair Digital Services in web and smartphone versions, as a unified space for citizens and economic operators to reach government services, per the High Commission for Digitalisation balance sheet of April 2024 to September 2026.
The article states that hundreds of public services have been digitised over the three-year period.

The Ministry of Post and Telecommunications says the Algerie Poste ECCP app offers online account consultation, statement download, Edahabia card request and tracking, SMS notification subscription and chequebook ordering.
